source_binding: Resolve this manifest at the selected commit and verify referenced blob identities.
coverage: Reviewed feature navigation and test candidates; not exhaustive semantic or runtime proof.

features.title: GitHub repository context and source lookup
invariants: Bind source ranges to the selected repository commit and blob.
Keep repository references, historical observations and personal documents distinct.
Graph edges and tests are candidates until verified.
A local preparation failure retains only closed phase/reason evidence; it cannot grant independent source-read authority.
Repeated blob deadlines retain incomplete coverage and bounded progress across restart; identity mismatches remain hard failures.

features.title: Conversation privacy and AI profile selection
invariants: Saved private-chat authority follows its conversation and queued work independently of global availability.
Profile selection is distinct from dispatch authorization.
Protected display ranges require content-bound masking evidence.
Final outbound privacy receipts contain counts, revisions and request-keyed fingerprints, never originals or replacement maps.
Private plain-text replies restore incrementally; local tool control remains separately validated.
Diagnostic content defaults to redacted; full forensic consent and resume identity are separate.
Synthetic local checks report measured privacy, intent and timing scope without claiming cloud quality or accelerator execution.
Masked fallback publication revalidates captured provider and retained-source authority before each output; revoked authority preserves partial failure and never replays output.
Ordinary modal collisions require positive detector classification and exact request-local copied-span provenance; protected overlaps and all other known-value checks remain authoritative.

Private stream events are revalidated after the channel handoff under captured conversation authority; denial stops upstream before one content-free partial failure, preserves cancellation and caller context, and never grants an error-code bypass.

A receiving-side denial carries generation_completed only from an actual observed Completed event; final accounting retains that content-free fact separately from failed delivery, transport completion and replay permission, never from upstream failure metadata.

An explicit provider comparison accepts only closed fictional fixtures, preserves the actual private dispatch/restoration and live authority checks, excludes saved personal text and tools, and keeps observed detection, task criteria, usage and timing separate. Only completed pairs with matching observed runtime/output ceilings enter grouped nearest-rank sample percentiles; warmups, incomplete or mismatched pairs and unverified strict-route settings are excluded.

Cancel the fictional provider comparison when its screen lifecycle stops or its composition is disposed; retain recorded and partial results, wait for provider cleanup, and require an explicit new Run after resuming.

Cancellation during a suspended non-null configured provider-authority check propagates unchanged at opening and pre-dispatch collection, retires owning and validating work, restores caller context and opens no provider in either comparison protection mode.

A typed final-wire privacy refusal survives actual network and adapter catches before physical dispatch, then passes through unchanged receiving authorization. Entirely unsent proof remains distinct from prior dispatched or uncertain work; cancellation, no replay and no invented completion remain authoritative.

features.title: Voice playback, captions and speech benchmarks
invariants: Presented audio and reply identity own caption position.
Synthesis completion does not imply playback completion.
Physical acceleration and latency require device measurements.
Plan complete utterances within native bounds and distinguish current execution, profile availability and qualified comparisons.
Retain exact workload, voice, rate, source and thermal identity; playback measurements do not establish acoustic latency or battery benefits.
Keep native progress polling separate from synthesis-owned evidence and retain audio/model ownership until actual retirement.
Playback comparison requires the current controlled workload protocol, independent fixture coverage and observed provider execution.
Benchmark and Auto ranking require same-run CPU-reference duration, token timing and signal consistency; numeric consistency does not establish perceptual equivalence.
Retain at most three exact accelerator token shapes under observed memory headroom and a hard estimate ceiling; unknown memory retains only the active shape.
One playback-scoped quiet limiter spans streaming callbacks and phrases; validate raw PCM first and account only retained audio in queued frames and cue positions.

An observed cue prefix may extend in place; a fully trimmed ending clears only the current presented word during refill, without advancing the caption clock, consuming a later onset or bypassing audio-focus pause.

Streaming reserve learning uses retained-PCM delivery gaps before phrase completion, excludes callback and bounded-queue waits, preserves an active-stream maximum and eight completed-stream maxima, and keeps whole-phrase ratio/word-cost accounting separate. Existing reserve, queue, caption, pause and cancellation bounds remain authoritative; synthetic tests do not establish acoustic continuity on a target phone.

features.title: Voice vocabulary, spoken elements and saved pronunciations
invariants: Shared projection preserves readable content and append-stable replay without exposing hidden reasoning or encoded source addresses.
Literal saved corrections precede native tokenization, match whole bounded terms once, and retain original caption ranges.
Native English normalization and SDK natural-language processing retain their own phonetic frontends.
Android utterances snapshot pronunciation settings and reject late callbacks after cancellation.
No raw vocabulary, matched terms or source speech is added to diagnostics; phonetic tests do not establish phone acoustic quality.

features.title: Streaming speech engines, preparation and playback admission
invariants: Stream PCM with bounded backpressure and retire native handles before releasing model leases.
SDK estimated word cues and requested delegates must not become native timing or executed-processor proof.
Only explicit model installation may download a speech pack; private conversations cannot send speech to Gateway.
Preserve original source ranges and pronunciation overrides when bounding long streaming replies.

Production accelerator playback requires complete same-run CPU-reference consistency before native open; explicit Recheck publishes its complete requested cohort and cancellation cannot grant partial admission.
Numerical audio consistency and SDK model smoke do not establish perceptual equivalence, arbitrary-utterance correctness or target-phone accelerator performance.

Gateway response retirement is bound to the exact admitted Work lease; cancellation and a fixed timeout plus validated audio duration bound transport without extending synthesis or retiring a replacement request.

Streaming reserve learning uses retained-PCM delivery gaps before phrase completion, excludes callback and bounded-queue waits, preserves an active-stream maximum and eight completed-stream maxima, and keeps whole-phrase ratio/word-cost accounting separate. Existing reserve, queue, caption, pause and cancellation bounds remain authoritative; synthetic tests do not establish acoustic continuity on a target phone.

features.title: GitHub editing, task continuation and validation
invariants: Reconcile uncertain writes before replaying a mutation.
Publication requires current source and applicable verification.
Workers cannot grant controller or mutation authority.
Settle interrupted phone-index work only after exact local ownership and unwind evidence; preserve unrelated unknown remote operations.
Argument canonicalization is separate from semantic repair and its observed execution outcome.
A native saved-page read and proven provider delivery are separate facts; continuation retains original context, output and attempt limits.
Fixture mutation authority comes from the accepted task policy; general tool auto approval does not grant it.

Every native-admitted unconsumed saved page receives bounded final-body replay space independently of call-ID spelling; matching context remains native-validated, and projected or unknown bodies cannot establish exact delivery.

Bounded explicit questions about this conversation use retained local session diagnostics; additional repository actions keep their own request, and historical inspection does not replace the active accepted task or grant new dispatch authority.

The mandatory PR/main credential-history gate runs the same pinned scanner against intact, missing-object and restored synthetic histories before the unchanged real reachable-history scan; a missing Git object, failed control or malformed mode cannot produce successful qualification.

features.title: GitHub model and context benchmark evidence
invariants: Freeze source, profile, task, budget and environment before comparison.
Hidden grader material never enters retrieval or model input.
Unknown cost, tokens and retrieval relevance remain unknown.

features.title: Gateway jobs, source mirror and development tools
invariants: The existing job owns source, execution, authority and publication.
Optional tool configuration never grants extra authority.
Exported source is not automatically model-admitted context.

features.title: Settled Markdown rendering and chat presentation
invariants: Keep privacy-sensitive content out of the shared parsed-document cache.
Retain current layout, font and theme inputs while reusing bounded settled parse results.
Device performance requires a measured device run.
A changed document revision clears the old rendered page while loading; reuse stays local, bounded and tied to current attribution.

features.title: Typed failure reports and diagnostic capture epochs
invariants: Keep diagnostic values within the shared closed vocabulary and exclude raw source/provider text.
Negotiate capabilities for newly introduced report fields while retaining compatible legacy payloads.
Require VOICE_STREAMING_BACKEND_EVIDENCE_V1 only for emitted new streaming voice enum values; retain ordinary voice V1 payloads and the bounded plain readiness response.
Do not combine observations across recording epochs or infer a historical crash cause without evidence.
Keep one valid aligned unmet-criterion sample and observed total/omission counts ahead of other summaries inside the unchanged diagnostic byte bound; malformed or unknown evidence gains no authority.
Protected payload reuse requires fresh row authority before and after redaction, complete digest/UTF-8 validation and unchanged privacy context.
Memory-pressure recovery preserves all source limits and headroom guards; complete export needs every bounded continuation part.
Require the shipped saved-page replay, local graph failure and provider-limit capabilities in hosted readiness probes, retaining the4096-byte bound and native-only no-probe routing.

Public final-request privacy evidence requires the exact typed code, admission/domain tuple, closed four-outcome vocabulary and negotiated capability. Keep raw private receipts out of approved reports, preserve prior unknown/accepted work against a later negative observation, and never infer an omitted historical reason.

Select the bounded extended readiness catalogue for saved-page replay, graph-local, provider-limit, replay-budget, graph-transport, task/tool and reader/run failure evidence before posting the exact approved report bytes; missing support never authorizes dispatch.

features.title: Android emulator acceptance readiness
invariants: Acceptance uses the same pinned emulator action after exact upstream commit/tree/clean-source and source/runtime digest verification removes only its premature MENU unlock. The real launcher/ANR/foreground readiness predicates, API matrix, memory and time limits remain unchanged.

An upstream revision, source digest, tracked or untracked mutation, or unexpected patch shape prevents execution before either target is written. Host command-order tests do not replace actual healthy API34/API36 instrumentation.

features.title: Qualified GitHub smoke reads and persisted integration evidence
invariants: Refresh only the same authorized repository, pull request and connection; retain bounded read retries and never replay mutations.
Validate retained path selectors against the selected repository and commit; reacquisition cannot establish complete historical coverage.
Saved page recipes, test execution receipts and remaining verification reserve are independent observations.
Fixture-specific accepted task approval remains authoritative through continuation.

Recover a legacy context head change through one fresh scoped LIVE header and one exact pinned read; cached observations, explicit or malformed pins, restored duplicate attempts and a second head change cannot expand the allowance.

features.title: Provider budget evidence, durable waits and streaming failure recovery
invariants: Only the actual dispatched remote command or job creates Gateway uncertainty; a saved local conversation key alone does not.
Durable retry requires current route authority, an unchanged output contract and replay-safe typed evidence.
Unknown or malformed budget metadata stays unknown; budget rejection never automatically changes output limits, spending policy or credentials.
Request, response and stream helper state belongs to one collection, preserving cancellation, accounting and cleanup order.
The packaged named-method guard measures unminified debug/benchmark DEX; release obfuscation and device latency are separate evidence.
HTTP error-body remote-job and reconciliation evidence prevents a new durable wait or manual budget delay and remains attached to the terminal failure.

Standalone accepted or unknown remote state, a closed reconciliation code and an explicit typed retry or replay refusal cannot establish a new known-unaccepted provider wait; raw string and true replay values cannot grant authority.
Durable-wait scheduling diagnostics are projected only for callers requesting durable waiting; ordinary transport retryability and the selected endpoint/model fence remain intact.

Validated retained backend attempts and partial usage survive HTTP rejection without sampling repair, tool-free replay, transient retry or credential rotation; complete bounded failure details retain observed status and stage, while missing token usage remains unknown.

features.title: Speech engine comparisons, bounded deadlines and measurement evidence
invariants: Unmeasured PCM is unknown, measured silence is explicit, and signed duration evidence never wraps or invents a zero sum after overflow.
Native shape residency remains memory admitted under the unchanged estimate ceiling and reserve; cold graph preparation is still required.
Stop a native candidate at its first known same-run CPU-reference mismatch unless deep diagnostics is explicit; preserve invalid evidence and independent candidates without granting qualification.
A preparation, chunk or backend deadline requests stop and publishes pending cleanup; only actual retirement permits reuse, and observer errors cannot skip cleanup.
Synthesis Stability collects20 warm repeats per fixture while percentile eligibility and thermal qualification remain explicit.
Only installed models may run; starting a benchmark never downloads a model or weakens captured conversation privacy.
SDK comparisons preserve actual voice, model, runtime and callback receipts without claiming native token timing, observed processor placement or perceptual quality.
SDK callback traces retain at most128 entries while total frames, costs and omission counts remain explicit; later callbacks never become caption violations solely because the trace is full.
Keep native generation wall time including graph preparation distinct from native inference and SDK retained-PCM production intervals; complete SDK stream-call time includes callback waits.
Keep frozen export reports in ViewModel memory and encode onIO; large reports must not enter Android saved-state bundles.
Preserve legacy numeric history without restoring stale qualification, and bound full stored history to4MiB by evicting older whole runs.
A failed native close retains the process-wide owner token and restart requirement across screen recreation; a stale lease cannot quarantine or release a replacement owner.
Failed native preparation retains its actual owner until confirmed destruction; a missing returned engine cannot authorize lease release.
An already-recorded deadline remains effective independently of delayed notification; measured partial PCM never implies completed audio validation.
Preserve unknown SDK stream-call counts as unknown in playback result displays; a missing observation is not a measured zero.

features.title: CPU preparation, zero-clipping admission and performance observations
invariants: Optional fixed-phrase CPU inference preparation is silent, bound to one resident model/speaker/rate and known cool thermal state; live speech cancels its attempt before queueing, and its delayed deadline cannot cancel later work.

Raw native PCM must contain zero clipped samples before delivery; reject contradictory successful clipping receipts and require zero clipping in both sides of CPU-reference protocol v2 without overwriting retained invalid observations.

Whole-device battery-counter observations retain optional raw endpoints and observed power events, preserve interrupted and unavailable states, and never establish engine-attributable energy, wattage, savings or a ranking winner.
Advisory first-PCM, RTF, zero-clipping and accelerator-share targets are distinct from observations and do not confer qualification.
Operator summaries expose only bounded public categories and first-shape profile count/time with explicit reuse and omission; observed CPU placement does not prove an unsupported operator.
Explicit unknown audio measurement availability stays unknown on restore; only legacy absence may use the existing compatibility inference.
Persistent context export must pass generation and reload qualification before production activation; the recorded failed host export does not qualify on-disk caching or physical hardware.

features.title: Public GitHub progress commentary and evidence-based summaries
invariants: Primary preview instructions remain outside the bounded repository snapshot and leave tool-free finalization; no extra remote narration call is added.
Publish completed public commentary with existing output lineage; never use private reasoning as progress text.
Each closed streamed preview is independent, bounded and owned by one model invocation; incomplete or mixed-origin blocks cannot publish.
New analysis can use already-read evidence; suppress repeated wording only within the same observed state and preserve new blockers and recoveries.
Issue and pull-request titles are descriptive data, not evidence of current failures or check counts.
Charts and exports preserve structured check counts, source identity and complete or incomplete captured coverage.
Routine summaries retain the existing 45-second first and 135-second follow-up cadence.

Only a bounded, call-bound immutable source capture can refresh preview repetition after a commit or result change; saved, negative, malformed or mismatched receipts do not gain current-source or completion authority.
